dialogue_summary: The user requests a deep, critical analysis of their own and the AI's contributions, roles, and interaction patterns throughout their project. The AI provides this evaluation, categorizing their collaboration styles and offering to suggest ways to improve the user's technical engagement.

step_1_outcomes.text: Comprehensive analysis of project contributions and interaction patterns
Analysis of individual contributions (user's creative vs. AI's technical)
Evaluation of user's role and interaction style using study analogies

step_2_requirements.text: The AI must perform a comprehensive analysis of the user's interaction patterns and contributions, excavating patterns across prompts and interactions.
step_2_requirements.rationale: The action explicitly states that the AI performs a comprehensive analysis of the user's interaction patterns and contributions, which is the core success condition for this outcome.

step_2_requirements.text: The AI must provide an analysis of the user's contributions and the AI's contributions to the project.
step_2_requirements.rationale: The user explicitly requests an analysis of what they have contributed and what the AI has contributed to the project so far.

step_2_requirements.text: The AI must identify the user's role in the project based on all previous prompts and chats.
step_2_requirements.rationale: The user explicitly requests the AI to identify their role in the project from all previous prompts and chats.

step_2_requirements.text: The AI must provide a highly critical, honest, and deep analysis of the user's interaction patterns, prompting patterns, and level of participation.
step_2_requirements.rationale: The user explicitly requests a very honest, 100% critical, and deep analysis of their interaction patterns, prompting ways, and participation level.

step_2_requirements.text: The AI must categorize the user's interaction style using analogies from the study (specifically Cyborg/Centaur and Self-Automator).
step_2_requirements.rationale: The user suggests using analogies from the study to categorize them, which the AI adopts and implements by evaluating them as a Cyborg/Centaur and Self-Automator.

step_2_slots.text: Whether the proposal should provide a concrete, low-cost way to convert a slice of the technical axis from abdicated to Centaur without slowing the build.
